data.title: Taj Hotel
data.description: Juhu is a popular seaside destination offering a beautiful coastline, lively beach atmosphere, local street food, and easy access to Mumbai's entertainment industry. Visitors can enjoy sunsets at Juhu Beach, try famous Mumbai snacks like pav bhaji and bhel puri, and explore nearby attractions. It is an ideal destination for families, couples, and tourists looking to experience Mumbai's coastal lifestyle.
